correctness.rationale: Reconstructed stationary Poisson solution (I-P)g=c-pi c, positive martingale variance from full-support transitions, analytic Perron pressure f(t)=log rho(diag(e^-tc)P) with f(0)=0,f'(0)=-pi c,f''(0)=sigma_GK^2. Uniform Birkhoff projective contraction of normalized row transitions gives O(k^(-gamma-1)) tracking of instantaneous left eigenvector and a summable O(k^(-2gamma-1)) error in the log-survival/Perron-product ratio. The pressure O(t^3) remainder sums iff gamma>1/3, yielding positive finite constant. Exact two-state covariance rho^j gives sigma^2=(1+rho)/(1-rho), so critical powers range (0,infinity). Independent numerical second-derivative checks for rho=-0.8,...,0.8 were performed; finite checks do not prove n->infinity.
